run_dpo_full_training: run DPO training on a preference dataset with a specified model and learning rate
run_dpo_lora_training: run DPO training with LoRA PEFT using lora_r and lora_alpha parameters
resume_dpo_training: resume DPO training from the last checkpoint in the output directory
evaluate_dpo_model: evaluate a DPO trained model using a configurable evaluation strategy and steps
push_dpo_model_to_hub: save the trained DPO model and push it to the HuggingFace Hub
